items.question: What is Arzonic Docs?
items.answer: Arzonic Docs is your central hub for documentation, guides, and resources to help you get the most out of Arzonic's products and services.

items.question: How do I navigate the documentation?
items.answer: Use the sidebar on the left to browse sections, or press Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on Mac) to quickly search for specific topics.

items.question: Is the documentation available in other languages?
items.answer: Yes! We currently support English and Danish. You can switch languages using the language toggle in the header or sidebar.

items.question: How do I report an error in the documentation?
items.answer: Use the feedback widget at the bottom of each page to let us know. Click the thumbs down button and describe what's wrong.

items.question: Can I request a new topic or guide?
items.answer: Absolutely! Reach out to our support team via the contact section, and we'll consider adding it to our documentation.

items.question: How often is the documentation updated?
items.answer: We update the documentation regularly as new features are released or existing content is improved based on user feedback.

items.question: Do I need an account to access the documentation?
items.answer: Most documentation is publicly accessible. Some advanced or internal resources may require you to sign in.

items.question: Who can I contact for further support?
items.answer: You can reach our support team through the contact section on this page, or send an email directly to our support address.
